_description: Per-post instructions for the upgrade desk, from the 2026-11-20 search-results gap analysis and the cannibalization review. seo_queue.py prints the note for the post it picks. A note stops applying once the post's 'upgraded' date is on or after the note's 'date'; the routine never edits this file. An optional 'priority' (1 first) puts a note ahead of the usual round robin until it is spent.
